column3: `this.find_friendly_opponent(club, list, n, band, excluir)`: finds a friendly opponent among the candidates of the band, or 0. \n The band (signed byte) is clamped to 1..=20; it searches (bsearch `exe::crt_bsearch` with `compare_friendly_candidates_by_band`, by byte +5) the candidate list (0x16 bytes, `n` of them) for one of the band, raising the band until found (from 20 on: the start of the list). From there up to the second-to-last candidate (the last one is left out, as in the original), it skips: the club itself, those in the `excluir` vector (4 pointers, by id), those that already have the club in their list (`preseason_candidate::OPPONENTS`, the cursor goes back to the start; `already_opponent`), those out by date, those of crossed bands (`preseason_candidate::WINDOW_START`/`preseason_candidate::WINDOW_END`, −1 = any), the rivals, those of rival nations (half the time: draw(2) = 0), those of the same division (`.division()`) and those above the drawn band (+4 > draw(3) + 3). By the club's reputation (`.reputation()`): below 2000 the same nation (`.nation()`); from 2000 to 3999 the same nation `nation::REGION`; from 4000 to 7999 the same `nation::CONTINENT`; with the club's +4 above draw(2), the same nation. It keeps the candidate when draw(5) = 1; none: 0. No SEH, no box.

`this.find_tour_opponent(club, ordenados, n, band_max, nation)`: finds a tour opponent among the candidates of the tour nation, or 0. \n It searches (bsearch `exe::crt_bsearch` with `compare_friendly_candidate_ptrs_by_nation`, by +6) the vector of `n` pointers to candidates, sorted by nation, for one of the nation (the id, [nation]) and steps back to its first one. From there up to the second-to-last: the first whose club (`.nation()`) is not of the nation ends the search (0); it skips those above the band (+5 > `band_max`), those out by date, the club itself, those that already have the club in their list (`preseason_candidate::OPPONENTS`, `already_opponent`), the rivals, those of rival nations (draw(2) = 0), those of the same division (`.division()`) and those above the drawn band (+4 > draw(3) + 3); it keeps the candidate when draw(2) = 1. None: 0. No SEH, no box.

Tells whether the fixture is the one the human manager chose to watch. \n Whether `fixture` is the one the human chose to watch: his record (the copy of the watched fixture at `human_manager_record::WATCHED_FIXTURE`..) with the same `.time_slice()`, dates (`.day()`, `.year()`), competition (`.comp_id()`), `.round_number()` and both sides (`.home_club_id()`, `.away_club_id()`). Null fixture or human out of range: the original routine runs (error box and 0).

Returns 1 to 3 from 100 × the value of the current contract / that of the desired one (with the deserved squad status), with an allowance for recent signings; below 50: 1; below 80: 3; otherwise 2. \n SEH frame with no destructor. `STAFF_CONTRACT::get_contract_satisfaction(person)`, called from the staff's daily pass (0x5ce2d0, with random(50) zero) and from the contract screen: 1 to 3. No person, 1. The squad status they deserve (`FN_CONTRACT_MANAGER_GET_DESERVED_SQUAD_STATUS`) is used if it is lower than the contract's (`contract::SQUAD_STATUS` >> 4) and is neither 0 nor 7; otherwise, the contract's. The desired contract (`exe::staff_contract_set_to_desired_contract` into a local contract, with the contract's club, −1, the status and 0xb) and the ratio 100 × value of the current contract (`calc_contract_value`, as f32) / value of the desired one (zero value: ratio 0). Signed less than 15 × loyalty (`.loyalty()`) + 100 days ago (from `contract::DATE_STARTED`, ceiling 500): ratio + 50 + 7.5 × loyalty − days / 2. Ratio below 50: 1; below 80: 3; otherwise 2.

The staff criterion (whether the person wants to leave): an 8-bit score (id mod 7, personality ratings, morale, the player's reputation, number of grievance groups) decides, by the grievances, whether it returns 1. \n The criterion of contract `t` (person `[t]` in `G_STAFF_TABLE`, `staff::SIZE` bytes; club `.club()` in `G_CLUB_TABLE`, `club::SIZE` bytes; grievance bits `.grievances()`): 0 if the person is the club's manager or assistant (`.manager()`, `.assistant_manager()`) or has no grievance; otherwise an 8-bit score (id mod 7 + `staff::LOYALTY` + `staff::PRESSURE` + `staff::PROFESSIONALISM`, deductions for low ratings and for a `staff::TEMPERAMENT` of 1, `.morale()` in bands, deductions for the player's `.current_reputation()` above 5750 and 7250, and, with more than one grievance group set, deductions by the number of groups) decides, by the grievances, the ratings and `.transfer_status()`, whether it returns 1.

Decides whether the weather postpones a match: only the home club's league matches at an uncovered stadium, outside the end of the key nation's season; by the evening slot and by the weather. \n `Weather::check_postponement(game)`, from the match day (`set_up_the_day`) and from the match preparation (`prepare_match`). Without a stadium (`.stadium()`) with a city (`stadium::CITY`) and places (`stadium::CAPACITY`), without a competition (`.competition()`), with the home club (`.home_club()`) outside a league (`.division()`) or the match outside its league, or a covered stadium (`stadium::COVERED`): 0. In the home club's key nation (`exe::key_nation_index_of_club`, table 0xb63d60 of 0x48 bytes), near the end of the year's season (`G_LEAGUE_WORLD_CUP_END_DATE`/+0x3b): 0. In the evening slot (`.time_slice()` = 2), by the home club's finances (`exe::financetable_get_club_finance`, band `exe::finance_get_wealth_band`): random(1000/2500/5000) zero returns 0x12. Then the match weather (`exe::weather_get_match_weather`, written into the argument's slot as in the original): rain 5 at 1 to 13 degrees, a stadium without under-soil heating (`stadium::UNDER_SOIL_HEATING`) of up to 20000 places: a random draw by places and home club (`.professional_status()`), zero = 9 (postponement); rain 8 (without under-soil heating, up to 15000 places) and 9 (ice; by wind 4 and by 10000 places): a chain of random draws that returns 0, 5 or 6.

For a player of the contract's club with a transfer request, no staff criterion and no agreed contract: withdraws the request (`exe::contract_manager_post_transfer_request_withdrawn_news`), morale becomes `staff::PROFESSIONALISM` + `staff::LOYALTY` + 5, `.unhappy_flag()` = 0, `.happiness()` at least 15, and clears each grievance, checking again. \n `STAFF_CONTRACT::check_transfer_request_withdrawal(ctx)`: when the decision (`should_withdraw_transfer_request`) says so, withdraws the request (`exe::contract_manager_post_transfer_request_withdrawn_news` on `G_CONTRACT_MANAGER` with the contract and `ctx`), clears bit 3 of `.transfer_status()`, the morale in the contract (`.set_morale()`) becomes the person's `staff::PROFESSIONALISM` + `staff::LOYALTY` + 5, clears `.unhappy_flag()` and raises `.happiness()` to 15; and each grievance that is set (bits 0x10, 1, 4, 8, 0x100, 0x80, 0x10000 of `.grievances()`, in that order) is cleared, checks again (`exe::staff_contract_check_transfer_request_withdrawal` with the previous `.grievances()`) and removes the opinion link (`exe::staff_remove_opinion_link` with the bit). No SEH, no error box, no random draw.
fills an international date: weekday, day, month, year offset, continent and competition

The end of the match day: frees the global list, the day's arrays and, for each match, the engine, the humans' scoreboard and the match summary. \n Frees the global list `G_MATCH_DAY_PLAYER_INCIDENT_LIST`, the two day arrays (`+1`, `+0xd`) and, for each match (`match_day_fields::MATCHES`, `0x69` bytes each, `match_day_fields::MATCH_COUNT` of them), the engine (`day_match::ENGINE`: `exe::drop_cm3_match_engine` and freed; the match leaves `G_VIRTUAL_STAFF` via `exe::virtual_staff_release_fixture`), the humans' network scoreboard (`day_match::SCOREBOARD`) and the match summary (`day_match::SUMMARY`, `exe::match_team_pair_destructor`); finally the match array.

Finds in the fixture list the match of a statistics record (date and clubs) and copies the fixture. Returns 1 if found. \n The fixture (`0x4f` bytes) of record `k` of the statistics index (`[stats]`, 12 bytes: `match_stats_entry::HOME_CLUB_ID`, `match_stats_entry::AWAY_CLUB_ID`, `+8`/`match_stats_entry::YEAR` the date): it asks the schedule `G_FIXTURE_MANAGER` (`exe::fixture_manager_find_fixtures`) for the matches of the home club on that date, in any competition, in a local list (`0x68d020`) and copies to `out` the first one with the away club (`match_stats_entry::AWAY_CLUB_ID`) at home (`fixture::HOME_CLUB_ID`) or away (`fixture::AWAY_CLUB_ID`). Index outside 0..`match_stats::CAPACITY` or null output: the original routine runs (error box, 0).

Sends the 0x138e news item with up to 3 records, the scout, the match and the player's strengths for the club, to the club's manager. \n Ret 8; SEH frame for the local news item: `SCOUT_MANAGER::send_scout_report_news(r, how_many)`, from the reports (`send_scout_reports`). News 0x138e (`exe::new_newsitem`): count (up to 3), `scout_report::REPORT_MODE`, the scouted player (`exe::write_staff_name_ref_to_news` with `scout_report::PLAYER_NAME_REF`), `scout_report::PLAYER_AGE`, `scout_report::POSITION_MASK`, club `scout_report::CLUB_ID`, the match data (`FN_WRITE_MATCH_RECORD_TO_NEWS`), `scout_report::HAS_MATCH`, `scout_report::LEAGUE_MATCH`, `scout_report::ELIGIBILITY_NOTE`, `scout_report::WORK_PERMIT_GRANTED`, from each of the records (`scout_report::SCOUT_NAME_REF` + 0x67 × k) +0xc, +0, +4, +8 and +0x26 + 8 × +0x25, 0x420e9 and the player's (`scout_report::PLAYER_ID`) strengths for the club (`exe::staff_get_player_strength_flags`); goes to the club's manager (`exe::news_send_to_club_manager`).

`Media::post_financial_trouble_news(club)` (SEH frame without a destructor): posts news item 0x1790 of the club in financial trouble to the managers of the nation, or to all for a big club. \n With the club, the nation (`.nation()`), the stadium (`.stadium()`, with a city `stadium::CITY`) and the division (`.division()`), it builds news item 0x1790 in a local (`exe::new_newsitem` with 0) with the data 0 = club id, 1 = reputation (`.reputation()`) and 2 = draw(2) (`exe::utils_random`); a club with reputation 9000 or more in a division with `.reputation()` above 12: to all managers (`exe::news_send_to_all_managers`); otherwise to those of the nation (`exe::news_send_to_nation_managers`). The local news item is 0xe0 bytes (the delivery copies only up to +0xde).

`Media::queue_sale_unrest_story(old, new, p, teammate)` (SEH frame for the local news item), called by the transfer reactions (`process_transfer_squad_reactions`): news item 0xbe4 of the team mate unhappy at the sale, to the old club's manager. \n An old club with a manager (`.manager()`), not a national side (`is_national_team`), a team mate and a player, each with a player sheet (`.player()`). The news item 0xbe4: the manager, the team mate and the player (id and the three keys of each), the ids of the two clubs, draw(2) (+2 if the team mate's `.professionalism()` is not above draw(5) + 10), the outlet (`exe::media_pick_outlet_type_for_club`), the pundit (`exe::punditlist_pick_random_pundit` with the nation `.nation()` or −1) and 2; it goes to the old club's manager (`exe::news_send_to_club_manager`).

Closes one of the day's matches: copies the day's match into the fixture, records the result in the competition (method 1, or the away-game path) and runs the post-match: players, events, contracts, suspensions, states, the history and each side's club. \n The closing of day match `p` (`0x69` bytes): copies the `0x4f` bytes from p+`day_match::FIXTURE_COPY` to the fixture (`+0`) and, with a competition (`fixture::COMPETITION`), reads the losing run of a human club (`G_COMP_OBJECT_TABLE` of the competition `+8`, `exe::comp_stats_find_club_entry`, `.losing_run()` above 1; as in the original, it looks only at the away club `fixture::AWAY_CLUB` on both passes) and records the result: p+`day_match::HOME_GOALS` = -3 (away game, `exe::weather_post_abandoned_news` with bits 12-13 of `.squad_rules()` and the copy with scores -1 in `exe::fixture_manager_find_new_fixture_date`/`exe::fixture_manager_add_fixture`) or method 1 of the competition. \n Then the post-match with the summary (p+`day_match::SUMMARY`): players (`exe::match_day_apply_post_match_player_changes`), events (`exe::match_day_process_player_incidents`), contracts (`0x4ca6d0`), suspensions (`0x55ca00`), `0x76b600` (except for -3), states (`0x62c080`) and, except for -3, the history (`G_RESERVE_COMP` method 1, outside `KEY_CLUB_COMP_RESERVE`), `0x7c0d70`, `0x8c39f0`, `0x444930`, `0x868830`, `0x4134c0`, `0x6951e0`, `0x59a5d0`, `0x7f8c00` and the club of each side (`FN_MATCH_DAY_POST_PLAYER_REACTION_NEWS` with that losing run). Without `p`, error `0x73f` and 0.

Draws a former international as the pundit for `club` (or to talk about `subject`), weighted by nation reputation and caps (`this` is not read). \n 150 rounds; in each it draws people (`exe::utils_random` with `G_STAFF_COUNT`, 110 bytes in `G_STAFF_TABLE`) until it finds one aged (`staff::AGE`) ≥ 37, with national team caps (`staff::INT_APPS`) ≥ 50, a non-player record (`staff::NON_PLAYER`), no club (`staff::CLUB_JOB`) if he has a player record (`staff::PLAYER`) and who is not the club's manager (`.manager()`); the 100th try ends the round. The weight is a draw of the nation's reputation (`staff::NATION`, `.reputation()`) × caps, doubled if he is from the subject's nation (without a subject: he must be from the club's nation, `.nation()`). From another nation: the reputation must beat 6500 + a draw of 100, the non-player record's `non_player::WORLD_REPUTATION` ≥ 6000 and the subject must not dislike him (`exe::staff_is_disliked_by`). The one with the highest weight is kept (the first accepted always gets in). Without a club and without a subject: 0.

`Media::pick_rival_manager_id(club)`: returns the id of the manager of a rival of the same league and much bigger, or of a drawn club in a league clash, who passes the draws; or −1. \n With a manager (`.manager()`) with a non-player record (`.non_player()`) and a league (`.division()`; without a league, only a national side, `exe::database_is_national_team`): the first of the manager's rejected list (`exe::staff_get_disliked_staff`) with a manager record and rating (`non_player::CURRENT_REPUTATION`) + 750 < rating (never: the draw(3) there does not happen); then each rival (+0xb3, +0xb7, +0xbb) with a manager who passes the draws, of the same league and with reputation (`.reputation()`) above the club's + 750, with draw(3) ≠ 0; then up to 50 drawn clubs (from `G_CLUB_COUNT` − 2 × `G_NATION_COUNT`) that make a league clash (`FN_COMP_UTIL_GET_LEAGUE_CLASH_TYPE`, with the draw limit as 3rd argument, a leftover on the original's stack) with a manager who passes the draws. Returns the manager's id, or −1.

The club's financial season end: ground purchase (20 million, from an owner in crisis), the squeeze, the AI club training facilities by random draw, undersoil heating (1.5 million) and roof (7.5 million), expansion or seating by balance and average attendance, the human's board requests (stadium and training) and the dividend by reputation, balance and chairman, with a random draw. 
 `FinanceTable::season_end_club_update(club)`, called from the nation's season end (`fin_prm_end_season_for_nation`). National team: nothing; no club: the error box (the original). The finances through the partner (`finance_of_parent_club`, `exe::club_get_linked_b_team`) and the balance (the low word, i32). With a stadium (`.stadium()`): 
 - not the owner (`.own_stadium()` = 0), with a league (`.division()`) and a balance above 35 million: buys the stadium for 20 million (`finance::MONTH_GROUND_COSTS`, `finance::SEASON_GROUND_COSTS`, balance; `.set_own_stadium(1)`; news 4, `post_works_news`), alone or from the owner (another club with the same stadium and `.own_stadium()`), if its finances are in crisis (`.crisis_state()` = 1 or 2): the owner stops being one (`.set_own_stadium(0)`) and receives the 20 million (`.month_other_income()`, `.season_other_income()`, balance; news 5); 
 - owner and with a league: the squeeze (`.squeeze_counter()` above 10, balance above 750 thousand) charges 10 − squeeze × 10000; the training facilities (`.training()` below 20) of an AI club with a manager (`upgrade_ai_training_ground`: `.manager()`, its `.non_player()` with `.youngsters()`) go up by random(40), charged to the club's own finances (level × 50000 + 75000, then up to 20 or one more level by reputation and balance); the human's stadium request (bit 6 of +2 of the manager row, `board_requests_row`) becomes the notice; the undersoil heating (stadium `.under_soil_heating()`, 1.5 million, news 6) and the roof (`.covered()`, 7.5 million); the expansion (by balance × 0.2, or × 0.1 when `.professional_status()` = `professional_status::PROFESSIONAL`, up to the ceiling `.expansion_capacity()` and a third of it; news 1 and 2) when the average attendance (`exe::comp_stats_find_club_entry` from the league table: ecx = `[comp + 8]`; push club; no add esp -> thiscall) exceeds 0.92 of the capacity (`.capacity()`), by reputation or by the notice; otherwise the seating (`.seating_capacity()`) by random(20) and the league's reputation (`.division().reputation()`), by balance × 0.2 / 75 (news 3); the ceiling goes up by 1500 below 30 thousand places; the refusal (`post_works_refused_news`) to the human who asked. 
 Then, the human's training facilities request (bit 7): above (500 − reputation) × 500, the upgrade (`exe::financetable_upgrade_training_facilities`: ecx = table; push club -> thiscall, ret 4; news 8), otherwise the refusal; and the dividend (`pay_dividend`: `.month_dividends()`, `.season_dividends()`, balance; news `exe::finance_post_dividend_news`: ecx = table; 2 pushes -> thiscall, ret 8) by reputation, balance and chairman (`.chairman()`), with random(501) in the two larger branches.

Computes the highest wage the club can offer: by reputation, wealth band and nation table; with a person, by the current contract, reputation squared, the roles, the human ceiling, the market, the contract near its end and the chairman; without a person, by the wage table less the payroll and budget per week, with the floor, the league and the nation; adjustments for clubs with `.professional_status()` 1 and 2, the league minimum + 100 and the lower of both ceilings. \n The asserts cite finance.CPP; 0x14ac bytes with x87. `person.get_max_wage(job_arg)`, called from the contract and transfer offers, the screens and the wage bill (`update_wage_bill`, without a person and with role −1). Club with `.professional_status()` = `professional_status::AMATEUR`: 0. The wage factor by reputation (/ 50, plus the wealth band `wealth_band` and the nation's wage table: 0x9c8498 small nations, 0x9c8548 medium, 0x9c85f8 France and clubs with `.plc()`, 0x9c86a8 the others) × 47.6 (ceiling 10000). With a person: the value of the contract at the club (`contract_wage`, up to 2 × the finances' ceiling `.wage_ceiling()`, at least that; a non-player without a player record (`.non_player()` without `.player()`) limited by role `.job_for_club()`), the bonus for the one who pays more (`big_spender_bonus`), reputation² × 0.25 × 0.0001 + the floor `.highest_wage()`, the rules for roles 1 to 3, the human's ceiling (`human_manager_wage_cap`), the nation (Basque club `exe::database_is_basque_club`, the market from the transfer manager's table `[G_TRANSFER_MANAGER]` → `shortlist_manager_fields::CLUB_SHORTLISTS`, the contract near its end `exe::date_days_since`), the chairman (`.chairman()`: the liking `exe::staff_is_favoured_by` and the favourite `exe::club_favours_staff`, the profile `.business()`, the manager `.manager()`) and roles 1 to 6. Without a person: the nation factor (`.league_standard()` / 20 × the type `.state_of_development()`, for type 1 nations), the league (`.division()` and `.last_division()`, its reputation `.reputation()` cubed), the table by (factor / 10) minus (`.wage_bill()` − (factor³ × nation / divisor + balance × 1.3) / 52), with the floor 0x9c83e8 or 0x9c8338, the band and the nation. Then the club with `.professional_status()` 1 and 2, the league minimum + 100 and the lower of the two.

Adds the weekly merchandising income: attendance × reputation × factor (by the chairman's business level or by reputation; Japan one step up), × (random(11) + 95)%, added to `finance::MONTH_MERCHANDISING`, `finance::SEASON_MERCHANDISING` and the balance. \n `FinanceTable::add_weekly_merchandising_income(club)`, called from the daily finance pass (0x59b9c0, on day 6 of the week, league clubs). The base: with the chairman (`.chairman()`) and his non-player record (`.non_player()`), the business level (`.business()`) × 25 + the reputation (`.reputation()`), × 0.65 truncated if byte `.own_stadium()` is zero, picks the factor by 5500 and 4000; without them, the reputation picks it by 5250 and 3750 (one step higher in the nation of Japan `KEY_NATION_JAPAN`). Attendance (`.attendance()`) × reputation × factor, truncated; × (random(11) + 95) × 0.01, truncated, added to `finance::MONTH_MERCHANDISING`, `finance::SEASON_MERCHANDISING` and the balance.

Tries a board payment of a poor club's debt (band −2/−1, or 0 with a low balance): after three random draws, the board pays 450, 300 or 150 × reputation and sends the news. \n `FinanceTable::try_board_debt_payment(club, fin)`, called from the events pass (`process_club_finance_events`). Band (`wealth_band`) −2, −1 (divisor 2, or 0.4 with reputation of 3500), or 0 with reputation up to 3500 and a balance below 25 × reputation (0.4); the others: 0. random(7000) + 3500 above the reputation; random(6 / divisor) zero; random(the resources `.resources()` of the non-player record `.non_player()` of the chairman `.chairman()`, or 10) not zero. The board pays 450 × reputation (below 1250 with a balance below −450 × reputation), 300 × (balance below −300 × reputation) or 150 ×: into `.season_other_income()`, `.month_other_income()` and the balance; the news (`post_finance_boost_news`, `exe::finance_post_finance_boost_news`, type 4); returns 1.

Tries a cash injection for a club of reputation 4750 outside Wales and the Irelands: random draws by the band and the chairman (`.chairman()`); the amount by reputation, up to 10% of the debt and 4 million; news and end of the crisis. \n `FinanceTable::try_cash_injection(club, fin)`, called from the events pass (`process_club_finance_events`). Reputation (`.reputation()`) of 4750, without flag `.plc()`, outside Wales and the Irelands. Divisor by the band (`wealth_band`; −2: 0.25; −1: 0.1; others: 0.001). With the chairman's (`.chairman()`) non-player record (`.non_player()`): random(30 / divisor) below the business level (`.business()`) and the resources `.resources()` above random(5) + 10: (20 × resources + 150) × reputation + 750000; without it: random(4 / divisor) zero: (5 × reputation + 15000) × 50. Debt above 10 × the amount: 10% of the debt. Ceiling: reputation² + 1.5 million below 2000; otherwise 4 million (+1 if the amount exceeds reputation² / 4). Into `.season_other_income()`, `.month_other_income()` and the balance; the news (`post_finance_boost_news`, `exe::finance_post_finance_boost_news`, type 3, with the budget `transfer_budget`); ends the crisis (`.set_crisis_state(0)`); returns 1.

Tries a cash boost for the club: outside seven nations and `.professional_status()` 2 and 3, the divisor by wealth band and reputation; with the chairman record, three random draws (against `non_player::BUSINESS`, the debt and 750 × `non_player::RESOURCES`) give (3 × (`non_player::RESOURCES`)² + 750) × reputation + 1 million plus the balance; without it, two draws give (reputation + 1000) × 1000; a third in three nations; then the money, the news by type and the end of the crisis. \n `FinanceTable::try_finance_boost_event(club, fin)`, called from the week's events pass (`process_club_finance_events`). Outside Wales, the Irelands and the nations of `KEY_NATION_NORWAY`, `KEY_NATION_DENMARK`, `KEY_NATION_SWEDEN` and `KEY_NATION_BELGIUM`, and without `.professional_status()` at 2 or 3. The divisor by the band (`wealth_band`): rich 0.001; 0 by reputation (up to 4250: 0.0125 with the chairman's (`.chairman()`) `.ambition()` and the record's (`.non_player()`) `non_player::RESOURCES` above 15, otherwise 0.0075; up to 6250: 0.05 or 0.025 the same way; above: 0.025); −1: 0.1 above 5250, 0.075 above 3250, 0.025; −2: 0.125 above 3750, 0.075. With the chairman's record: random(its `non_player::BUSINESS`) above random(30 / divisor), random(`non_player::RESOURCES` × 1 million) above the debt and reputation below 750 × `non_player::RESOURCES`: (3 × (`non_player::RESOURCES`)² + 750) × reputation + 1 million, plus the low balance (less if the balance is negative), with the ceiling of reputation² + 1.5 million below 2000. Without it: random(15000 / divisor) below the reputation and random(8) zero: (reputation + 1000) × 1000. A third in the nations of `is_scandinavian_club` (`KEY_NATION_SWEDEN`, `KEY_NATION_NORWAY` and `KEY_NATION_DENMARK`). Into `.season_other_income()`, `.month_other_income()` and the balance (`credit_income`); the news (`post_finance_boost_news`, `exe::finance_post_finance_boost_news`) by type (by the budget `transfer_budget`, the flag `.plc()` and random draws of 4: 3, 5, 6, 7 with `.set_plc(1)`, or 1); with the record, its `.resources()` drops by 1 above 5; ends the crisis (`.set_crisis_state(0)`); returns 1.

Processes a match's money: the TV money by attendance (1.75 × attendance), the gate receipts (`.gate_receipts()` of the result), the match costs and the home club's expenses (with random draws), the competition TV money by stage or type, divided by the nation type; in the home club's league, TV 3/4 and 1/4, the net to the home club and the stadium upkeep; outside it, half of each to both. \n `FinanceTable::process_match_income(fixture, result)`, called from the closing of the day's match (`close_day_match`). No result or no fixture: the error box (the original). A national team on either side: nothing (`match_club_finance`). The amounts: with attendance (`.attendance()` of the result), the TV by attendance (1 / (random(10) + 2) as an integer, which is 0, plus 1.75, × attendance) and the gate receipts (`.gate_receipts()`); the match costs (when neither club has `.professional_status()` = `professional_status::PROFESSIONAL`: attendance × 0.25; otherwise by bands of attendance or of the capacity `stadium::CAPACITY` of the fixture's stadium `.stadium()`, with a floor of 500 by flag `.home_side_mark()`); the home club's expenses (with `.professional_status()` = `professional_status::PROFESSIONAL`: random + attendance × 1.25 + reputation / 2 + 300, × 1.25 above 4750, or random(400) + attendance × 1.25 + 600 without reputation; otherwise two random draws + attendance); the competition TV money by stage (`.stage()`) or type (`.category()`: finals by the reputations, 6 and 4 by the competition's `.reputation()`); all divided by the nation type (`.state_of_development()`: 2 and 3) and once more in Wales and the Irelands. In the home club's league (`.division()` = `.competition()`, not at a neutral ground `.neutral_venue()`): TV 3/4 to the home club and 1/4 to the away club (+0x158, +0xb8, balance), the net to the home club (+0x140, +0xa0, balance) and, with its own stadium (`.own_stadium()`, `.stadium()`), the upkeep ((random(15) + 1) × 0.01 + 0.85) × the stadium's `stadium::CAPACITY` (`finance::SEASON_GROUND_COSTS`, `finance::MONTH_GROUND_COSTS`, subtracted from the balance). Outside it: half of each to both.

Sells season tickets: stadium of at least 1500 places; demand by the manager-table value, attendance and reputation, up to 87.5% of the places; new holders by the step fraction (`.season_ticket_step()`) and a random draw; ratio at `finance::SEASON_TICKET_RATIO`; income (with apply) by price, nation type and key clubs; the shop with two random draws by reputation. \n `apply.sell_season_tickets()`, called from the daily finance pass (0x59b9c0, on day 6 of the week, when finance_get_days_to_season_start `finance_get_days_to_season_start` says the season is still to start). The club by id (`.club_id()`, 0x245-byte record); a stadium (`.stadium()`) with fewer than 1500 places (`stadium::CAPACITY`) uses reputation × 2.5 (minimum 1500). The demand: the club's value in the managers' manager (`[[G_MANAGER_MANAGER]]` + 73·id + 8) × 0.0001 (minimum 0.15) × attendance (`.attendance()`), × reputation × 0.00025 (minimum 0.5), capped at 87.5% of the places (1250 without a stadium). Above those already sold (`.season_tickets_sold()`): the step (`.season_ticket_step()`, up to 8) picks the fraction (0x9c8758) of the difference, × (random(11) + 95) / 100 = the new ones; the sold/places ratio goes to `.season_ticket_ratio()` (f32, up to 0.875). The income (price by reputation × new ones; /4 or /10 by the nation type `.state_of_development()`; × 1.25 in Serie A, Chelsea 1.5, Arsenal and Tottenham 1.3, Everton 0.75, Liverpool 0.9, Germany 1.2) is added only with `apply` (`.month_season_tickets()`, `.season_season_tickets()` and the balance); then (random(rep) + random(rep) + 1) × 0.001 + 1, × new ones, into `.season_merchandising()`, `.month_merchandising()` and the balance.

Recomputes the wage bill: sums the squad wages (less the other club's share for loanees) and the staff wages into the wage bill (`finance::WAGE_BILL`) and the highest wage (`finance::HIGHEST_WAGE`); with fewer than 15 players, the missing places at a wage by reputation; plus reputation² × a factor by club type and nation; the wage ceiling (`finance::WAGE_CEILING`) by `get_max_wage`. \n `Finance::update_wage_bill()`, called from the daily finance pass (0x59b9c0, on Saturdays, clubs with a nation), contract signing (`sign_contract`), the daily contracts pass (0x4c7ac0), loans (`sign_loan_contract`, `end_loan`) and the wage bills at creation (`refresh_all_wage_bills`). Clears the highest wage (`finance::HIGHEST_WAGE`) and the bill (`finance::WAGE_BILL`) and sums the wages (the contract's `contract::WAGE`) of the 50 squad slots (`.squad(k)`; contract with the club `exe::contract_manager_get_contract_for_club`; wage −1: the default wage `exe::staff_contract_default_staff_contract` truncated; on loan (`exe::contract_manager_get_loan_contract`) outside type 6 (`contract::CONTRACT_TYPE`): minus the other contract's wage) and of the staff (+0x19f × 5, +0x1b3 × 7, +0x1cf × 3, contract `exe::contract_manager_get_contract`). Squad with fewer than 15 slots filled: the missing ones at a wage by reputation (`.reputation()`: above 4750, rep − 1950; above 2250, (rep − 2250) × 0.5 + 550; otherwise rep × 0.25; outside type 1 (`.professional_status()` = `professional_status::PROFESSIONAL`), × 0.5; divided by the nation type (`nation::STATE_OF_DEVELOPMENT`, between 1 and 3)). Plus reputation² × k (type 1: England and Italy 0.001 / 0.0008 / 0.0006 above 5250 / 3250; others 0.0004; outside type 1: 0.0002 above 3250, otherwise 0.0001), truncated. The wage ceiling (`finance::WAGE_CEILING`) is redone by Finance::get_max_wage (`FN_FINANCE_GET_MAX_WAGE`, 0, −1).

Adjusts the board's confidence after the match: the rivalry, the reputation gap or the team and opponent ratings in the match, the score, the aggregate, the derby and rival, the competition weight; writes the four confidence values (1 to 10000, with floors by stage), raises the media stories and the fan protest, and decides whether to consider sacking the manager. \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::update_board_confidence_after_match(club, fixture, game, home)`, called from the board after the match (`update_board_after_fixture`, one side at a time). The adjustment starts from the rivalry (±20/30 against the opponent or by the fixture's national side `.stadium()`), adds the reputation difference / 35 (without a match) or, with the match, the team rating (average of the player ratings weighted by the minutes on the pitch, `match_record::ROW_MINUTE_LEFT_PITCH`; the side's shots and shots on target, `.home_shots()`/`.home_shots_on_target()` of its block; the shot difference with the opponent; the sum of +0x4d − rating; x87: (... + 0.1) × 67 − 470, × factor) plus the average reputation of the opponents (by nation, `exe::database_is_staff_foreign`) against the club's / 40, up to ±100. By the score (`fixture::HOME_GOALS_EXTRA_TIME`/`fixture::AWAY_GOALS_EXTRA_TIME` or `fixture::HOME_GOALS`/`fixture::AWAY_GOALS`): win 0x800, defeat 0x1000 (outside friendlies, × 2 or × 5 with a thrashing; below −50 with an AI manager, the request to the FA `exe::manager_manager_handle_fa_request` by random draw), draw 0x400 (in the cup, +15 and the stages 0x7b/0x7c/0x85/0x86/0x99/0x9a). The aggregate (`.home_aggregate()`/`.away_aggregate()`, `.home_penalties()`/`.away_penalties()`, `.home_goals()`/`.away_goals()`) gives 0x100/0x200 and ±10/15/20; the derby (0x40, same city or a rival within 25 km) or the rival/clash (0x80) multiply the weight (2.25 or 1.5) and give ±12/±5. Weight × 0.5 for the B national team, × 2 for the senior one, × 2 or 1.5 in the cup (flag `expectation_flags_byte1::EUROPEAN_SUCCESS` (0x400) of the row's `board_record::EXPECTATION_FLAGS`); the adjustment × weight, ÷ 3 or ÷ 2 by the flags. The flags 1/2/4/8/0x10/0x20 (by the score, the adjustment and confidence `board_record::CONFIDENCE`) go into the text (`FN_MANAGER_MANAGER_BUILD_BOARD_MATCH_REACTION_TEXT`) and into the reaction news (`exe::manager_manager_post_board_match_reaction_news`, human manager only). The media story 0x3d (`exe::media_post_team_media_story`, −250 at `board_record::FAVOURITES_MOOD`) by random draw at a manageable club; story 0x5c in the league with the club in danger. The confidence: `board_record::CONFIDENCE` += 0.7 ×, `board_record::STAFF_CONFIDENCE` += 0.5 ×, `board_record::SUPPORTERS_CONFIDENCE` += 1.15 ×, `board_record::CONFIDENCE_4` += 0.2 × (half with flag `exe::player_regen_get_retirement_status` when negative), between 1 and 10000; floors by stage and by the competition's strength; the fan protest (`exe::manager_manager_post_supporter_protest_news`); in the league or when negative, consider sacking (`exe::manager_manager_consider_sacking_manager`, 1 on a defeat); otherwise it leaves the ultimatum list (`manager_manager_fields::ULTIMATUM_LIST`, `exe::llist_remove`).

After the match, by a random draw, gathers the league position for the news and the chairman's favoured or rejected players who played badly, with the board confidence rising or falling because of them. \n Called from the board's news after the match (`post_board_match_reaction_news`): `(game, club, ids, fixture, elogio, a6..a10)`. Sets the 3 ids to −1. Club outside the national teams with a chairman (`.chairman()`) with a non-player record (`.non_player()`): random(the record's `.interference()`) against random(10); if it passes, it clears the 5 outputs and, in a match of the club's division, a10 = 1 and, from the league table (`exe::comp_stats_find_club_entry`, with more than 8 matches, `.matches_played()`), a9/a8 (the row's `.best_position()`/`.current_position()`), a7 (the board's `board_record::TARGET_POSITION`) and a6 (2 or 0xfe by the row's `.winning_run()`/`.losing_run()`). The players (job 11, with a record) that the chairman rejects (`FN_STAFF_GET_DISLIKED_STAFF`, if `elogio` = 0) or favours (`FN_STAFF_GET_FAVOURED_STAFF`), of the club by contract (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract`, the result kept in `G_CONTRACT_LOOKUP_RESULT`), below the club's reputation (rejected) or up to 35 years old and above it − 750 (favoured), with a rating below 7 in the match (`exe::get_player_match_rating_verdict` = −1): their ids go into `ids` and the board confidence (`board_record::CONFIDENCE`) rises (favoured) or falls (rejected) by 10 × the chairman's `.ambition()`. Returns the sum of the two counts (the caller does not read it).

Resets the club board and picks the manager for the vacancy: the best score among the free people who qualify (or the assistant, or the first free one counting backwards), sometimes a better drawn one; the announcement and arrival dates and the item in the vacancy list; the human managers apply. \n SEH frame with no destructor on the normal path. `MANAGER_MANAGER::add_job_vacancy(club, left)`. Club without a division and with reputation below 5000: nothing; B national team whose nation has up to 1000 people (`.number_staff()`), or senior team whose nation has up to 100: nothing. The board starts over (the four confidence values 5000, `board_record::EXPECTATION_FLAGS` = `expectation_flags::AVOID_RELEGATION`, the flags cleared). The chosen one: from all people with a manager record (`staff::NON_PLAYER`; the last 16, the humans, only with `staff::CLASSIFICATION`), except the one who left, without state 0x30 (`staff_state_byte_b`), without a contract (`loan_contract_of`), off the lists (`is_vacancy_candidate`), of the same nation or with `non_player::CURRENT_REPUTATION` ≥ 3750, of the same continent (`nation::REGION`) or with `non_player::WORLD_REPUTATION` ≥ 4250 and the club with reputation ≥ 4750, suited to the job (`is_staff_suitable` with 3.5), excluding players with a contract in force in jobs 11/12/13/15, only national team managers (`staff::JOB_FOR_CLUB` = 5) for a national team: the highest score (`score_candidate`, `exe::score_staff_for_job`). With nobody: the assistant (`.assistant_manager()`), the first of `.coaches(0)` or, from back to front starting at the 17th from last, the first free person in jobs 0, 5, 6, 7, 8, 11, 12, 15 (without wrapping around: the "Can't find a manager" box and nothing). National team or big club (reputation above 4500 + random(2000)): draws as many people as their count and keeps the best free one (with 150 days in the job, 3.15). The human rejected by the club (`exe::staff_add_disliked_club`). The dates: before the game start, 1 to 7 days after it (the announcement) and the arrival 1 to 7 days later; otherwise, the announcement in 1 to 3 days and the arrival in 4 to 8 days (7 to 11 if the one who left is human; 10 to 14 with the offer news `exe::manager_manager_post_job_offer_news` to the chosen one's human club), sometimes 0 to 19 more; the turn of the year. The item goes into list `manager_manager_fields::VACANCY_LIST` (`exe::llist_add_tail`, the cursor `llist::CURSOR` saved); the humans (`exe::human_manager_is_on_holiday`, `exe::human_manager_get_holiday_option`) of smaller clubs apply (`exe::manager_manager_apply_for_job`).

Considers sacking the manager: with low board confidence and the manager in the job for 150 days, the limit comes from the division table, the runs and the manager flag; chairman draws hold back, issue the ultimatum, let the manager leave or sack him (the departure queued, reason `get_departure_reason`), or look for a better candidate with the pressure story. \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::consider_sacking_manager(club, check)`: before the date `[G_GAME_START_DATE]` (`exe::date_operator_3c`), with bit `board_record_flags::DEPARTURE_QUEUED` in `board_record::FLAGS` of the board row, with the ultimatum resolved (`exe::manager_manager_resolve_board_ultimatum`, only with `check`), with confidence (`board_record::CONFIDENCE`) above 4275 or with the manager in the job for less than 150 days: nothing. A well-regarded manager (the non-player's `non_player::CURRENT_REPUTATION` above 5000 and above the club's reputation `.reputation()` − 750) for less than 400 days: with random(chairman's patience `non_player::PATIENCE`, or 10) ≠ 0 the confidence goes to 4275. The limit (10 above 3500, 500 up to 3000, 200 in between) changes by the club's row in the division table (`exe::comp_stats_find_club_entry`): more than 30 − patience/2 matches played (`.matches_played()`) in the top places (`.best_position()` within `league::PROMOTION_PLAYOFF_COUNT`, or `league::PROMOTED_COUNT` by the competition's `league_vtable::HAS_AUTOMATIC_PROMOTION`) holds; the last 5 results (+0x14..+0x18) averaging above 2 hold; the runs `.winning_run()`, `.unbeaten_run()`, `.winless_run()` and `.losing_run()` move the limit (×1.5 on `.winless_run()`). With the manager flagged (`exe::player_regen_get_retirement_status`), the limit ×0.25. random(patience × 50, or 500) above the limit holds; random(patience + 1, or 11) = 0 gives the ultimatum (`exe::manager_manager_issue_board_ultimatum`; once given, nothing more). An AI manager (`exe::human_manager_is_human_club`), without the flag, with random(`.pressure()`) and random(4) zero leaves (departure 2, `record_departure`). With a chairman: at a league club or national team, random(patience) < 5 and random(20) ≠ 0 tries to swap for the best candidate (`check_better_candidate`); otherwise the pressure news (`exe::manager_manager_post_manager_under_pressure_news` with 2) after 14 days (`.last_review_date()`), and that is all. Without a chairman: random(3) = 0 tries the swap. Without a swap, the non-player's confidence (`.current_reputation()`) drops by 250 (minimum 1500 with a chairman, 1 without) and the manager is sacked (departure 1).

Returns the reason (0 to 11) for the manager's departure: unsettled players, league position, debt, board changes and moods (with random draws) and time in the job. \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::get_departure_reason(id)`: the reason (0..11) for the departure of the manager of club `id`. National team (`exe::database_is_national_team`): 0. More than 2 squad players with grievance 0x10000000 in the contract (`contract::GRIEVANCES`): 9. In the season (`exe::club_is_in_season`): in the league with the nation flagged (`.league_selected()`), a table row with more than 25 matches played (`.matches_played()`) and a winless run (`.winless_run()`) above 1, by the competition's position 0x9c: progress (`.current_position()`) inside and the projected position (`exe::comp_stats_get_club_projected_positions`) outside the (`league::CLUB_COUNT` − `league::RELEGATED_COUNT`) places: 11; debt (double `board_record::SPENDING` < `board_record::SQUAD_INVESTMENT`) with the change `board_record::LEAGUE_CONFIDENCE` below −300: 10. Then: `board_record::LEAGUE_CONFIDENCE` below −750 outside a type 1 run (`exe::manager_manager_get_current_run`) with a random draw of 3 = 0: 2; in the season with bit `board_record_flags::PROJECTED_BELOW_TARGET` of `board_record::FLAGS`: 7; +0x10 < −350: 3; `board_record::TRANSFER_MOOD` < −750: 5; mood `board_record::STAFF_CONFIDENCE` below confidence `board_record::CONFIDENCE` and random(`board_record::STAFF_CONFIDENCE`) < random(`board_record::CONFIDENCE`): 8; `board_record::FAVOURITES_MOOD` < −750 with a random draw of 3 ≠ 0: 4; the manager in the job for more days (`exe::date_days_since` since `.date_joined_club()`) than 1000 + a random draw of 2000: 6. Otherwise 0.

Removes the club from the ultimatum list and, when the manager has been in the job over 100 days, queues his departure (reason 2, or 7 without a winless run in the table) and returns 1. \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::resolve_board_ultimatum(club)`: walks the ultimatum list (`manager_manager_fields::ULTIMATUM_LIST`, up to the count, which drops with each removal) and removes the club's item (`exe::llist_remove`); if the manager (`.manager()`) has been in the job for more than 100 days (`FN_DATE_DAYS_SINCE` since `.date_joined_club()`), it puts the departure in the list (`manager_manager_fields::DEPARTURE_LIST`, `exe::llist_add_tail`, 6 bytes: 1, reason 2, or 7 if the club's row in the division table (`exe::comp_stats_find_club_entry`) has no winless run (`.winless_run()` ≤ 0), and the club's id), sets bit `board_record_flags::DEPARTURE_QUEUED` in `board_record::FLAGS` of the board row and returns 1. Otherwise 0.

Fixes the national team jobs of staff (manager at the team's `club::MANAGER`) and builds each club's board row: dates, reputation squared, the four confidence values drawn from the expectation (board rating or reputation) and the reputation, held to 5750/5500..10000, or 5000 without a manager; the season expectations (`exe::manager_manager_set_season_expectations`) and, without a manager, the vacancy (`exe::manager_manager_add_job_vacancy`). \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::init_club_board_records()`: at the start of the career (from the constructor 0x68dbf0). (1) Each person with a national team job (`.national_job()`, the team's club record): function (`.job_for_nation()`) 5 or 12 becomes that team's manager (`club::MANAGER`); 11 stays; 13 and 15 become 11 (`job_kind::PLAYER`, with a player record `.player()`) or 8 (`job_kind::COACH`); the others lose the national team job; without a club (`.club_job()`) and without a club function (`.job_for_club()` = `job_kind::UNEMPLOYED`), the national function goes to `.job_for_club()`; outside 11 the national function is cleared (`job_kind::UNEMPLOYED`). (2) Each club (national teams only with a nation and `nation::CONTINENT`): the second national team has its reputation (`club::REPUTATION`) capped at 200 × the nation's (`nation::REPUTATION`) and the slots cleared; its row (73 bytes in `[this]`) gets the dates (23/07/1971 at `board_record::LAST_ULTIMATUM_DATE`, today at `board_record::LAST_REVIEW_DATE`), reputation² × 0.25 (double at `board_record::SPENDING`) and zeros. With a manager: the date 23/08/1971 at `board_record::JOB_APPLICATION_DATE` (by the id's row), the expectation `f` (the reputation, the board rating `non_player::CURRENT_REPUTATION` or 4500, which drops to 0.75 × reputation), `h` = f / (reputation × 0.5 + 2500) × 7500 and the four confidence values (`board_record::CONFIDENCE`, `board_record::SUPPORTERS_CONFIDENCE`, `board_record::STAFF_CONFIDENCE`, `board_record::CONFIDENCE_4`) by random draws (`roll_confidence`), clamped below (5750, or 5500 with a draw) and above (10000; `.confidence()` above 9500 becomes 10000 − random(500)); clears the flags (`clear_board_flags`) and sets the season expectations (`exe::manager_manager_set_season_expectations` with 1). Without a manager (outside the partner club, `exe::club_get_linked_b_team`): confidence 5000, `.set_expectation_flags(expectation_flags::AVOID_RELEGATION)`, flags cleared; a manageable club (`exe::club_can_be_managed`, or one with a competition and a nation with `nation::LEAGUE_SELECTED` & 3) gets the expectations and the vacancy (`exe::manager_manager_add_job_vacancy`).

Flags the deal for buyer and seller by the fee/player value ratio (bands for values above or up to 250,000; a fee up to (reputation × 0.2)² is fair), adds and subtracts the value from each one's net spend and flags the club's and chairman's favoured or disliked player. \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::assess_transfer_deal(transf, f1, f2)`: with the player (`.target_staff_id()`) who has a record (`.player()`), clears the two flag words and: for the buying club (`.buyer_club_id()`, 0x245-byte record) adds the player's value (`player_value_for_club`, 1 if 0) to the net spend (`board_record::SQUAD_INVESTMENT`) and flags `f1` by the ratio fee (`exe::transfer_offer_get_total_value`) / value: fee up to the limit (reputation × 0.2)² (`fee_limit`) = 4; value above 250,000: < 0.2 = 0x10, < 0.5 = 8, < 2 = 4, < 6 = 2, otherwise 1; up to 250,000: < 0.125 = 8, < 8 = 4, otherwise 2; the favoured or rejected player of the club or of the chairman (`.chairman()`; `exe::club_favours_staff`/`exe::club_dislikes_staff`/`exe::staff_is_favoured_by`/`exe::staff_is_disliked_by`) = 0x40 or 0x100. For the selling club (the player's `.club_job()`) it subtracts the value from the spend and flags `f2` with the mirrored bands (0.25/0.5/2/4; 0.125/8) and 0x20 or 0x80. A loan offer (`.offer_type()` = 1): nothing (the flags stay as they are).

Changes the board confidence (`board_record::CONFIDENCE`, 1..10000) and moods (`board_record::TRANSFER_MOOD`, `board_record::FAVOURITES_MOOD`) of the buyer and the seller from the deal flags and removes the player from the seller chairman's favoured people. \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::apply_transfer_confidence_changes(transf)`: assesses the deal (`exe::manager_manager_assess_transfer_deal`) with the buyer's flags in the slot of the argument itself and the seller's in the slot of the pushed `ecx` (a loan offer, `.offer_type()` = 1: the pointer's bits stay, as in the original) and changes the board row of the buyer (`.buyer_club_id()`) and, if the seller (the player's `.club_job()`) is not a national team (`exe::database_is_national_team`) and does not have finances with `.crisis_state()` = 1 (`exe::financetable_get_club_finance`), the seller's: ratio 1: −125/−500, 2: −25/−250, 8: +25/+25, 0x10: +75/+75 (confidence `board_record::CONFIDENCE` and mood `board_record::TRANSFER_MOOD`; `apply_reason_flags`); favoured and rejected on mood `board_record::FAVOURITES_MOOD` (and `board_record::TRANSFER_MOOD`). Clamps the confidence to 1..10000 and `board_record::FAVOURITES_MOOD` to −10000 or more (`clamp_board_row`); at the end the player is removed from the seller chairman's favoured people (`exe::staff_remove_favoured_staff`).

The AI's bids and loan requests for a computer club with an active shortlist: in each slot with a target and no offer it checks the role, contract, reach and offer rules; in a purchase slot it values the slot and bids if random(value) beats random(2 × reputation + 1000); in a loan slot it checks whether the loan is possible and makes the request if random(`shortlist_slot::PRICE`) beats random(reputation / 10) or random(2 × reputation). 
 Convention: thiscall, ret 4, `shortlist_manager.cpp`, SEH frame: local STAFF_CONTRACT and offer, only the offer with a destructor. `Shortlist_Manager::make_club_bids(club)`, from the day loop (`0x5cccd0`). Today + 7 (`exe::date_add_days`) and a local STAFF_CONTRACT (`exe::new_staff_contract`). National team (`exe::database_is_national_team`), human club (`exe::human_manager_is_human_club` with 0, 1), or a human on holiday (with 1, 1) whose manager responds (`FN_HUMAN_MANAGER_IS_ON_HOLIDAY`) with rule 4 (`exe::human_manager_get_holiday_option`) equal to 1: nothing. The club's list (the 9-byte record in `shortlist_manager_fields::CLUB_SHORTLISTS`): active (`club_shortlist::ACTIVE` = 1), with fewer than 100 days (`club_shortlist::DAYS`) and finances (`exe::financetable_get_club_finance`). The count = slots with a player bid (`exe::shortlist_manager_count_slots_with_bids` with `0xb`) + the squad (`exe::database_count_club_squad` with 0, 0). 
 Each of the 40 slots of `0x25` bytes with a target (`shortlist_slot::TARGET_STAFF_ID`) and no offer (`shortlist_slot::OFFER_REF` = −1), except player slots when the count is at 50: the target outside the club; in slots for another role, role 8/9/10 with a free place in lists `+0x19f` (5), `+0x1b3` (7), `+0x1cf` (3) and role 6/7 with no `.assistant_manager()`; without bits `0x30` of `+0xb` of the 79-byte record (`staff_state_byte_0b`; player slot), no future transfer (`exe::transfer_manager_get_future_transfer`), agreed contract (`exe::transfer_manager_get_agreed_contract_club`) or a national team manager job (`.national_job()` with `.job_for_nation()` = `job_kind::MANAGER`). 
 Purchase slot (`shortlist_slot::FLAGS` bit 0, `shortlist_slot_flags::LOAN_SLOT`, clear): position (`+1`) not negative in a player slot; the club can reach him (`exe::transfer_manager_can_club_bid_for_player`, or reason 9); no offer from the club for him (`exe::transfer_manager_club_has_offer_for_player`) and no exchange (`exe::transfer_manager_get_exchange_offers_for_player`). The value = `shortlist_slot::PRICE` (doubled with bit `shortlist_slot_flags::BID_MARKER`, at least 20000); with the league (`.division()`) active in `[G_COMP_OBJECT_TABLE]`, × 3 or × 2 by reputation (`.reputation()` above `0x128e`) and the count below 25/35, or × 2 below 25. Player slot with a player to replace (`shortlist_slot::REPLACEMENT_STAFF_ID`): unable to sign (`exe::transfer_manager_can_sign_player` with today + 7, 1; except reason 9) adds `shortlist_slot::PRICE` (at least 10000); the injury of the player to replace (`exe::injury_get_player_injury` on `[G_INJURY]`, three times) adds days² (`injury_entry::DAYS_LEFT`) × (reputation / 500); with a player sheet, (1.5 − the player's morale, `.player_morale()` of the sheet, / 30) × value; under offer (`exe::transfer_manager_is_player_under_offer`) adds max(`shortlist_slot::PRICE` × 1.5, 10000). Player slot with a human seller (or the target already at the club): the desired contract (`exe::staff_contract_set_to_desired_contract`) 0 skips; wage (`.wage()`) above 1.3 × the cap (`exe::finance_get_max_wage`) skips. 
 The random draws (`exe::utils_random`): random(value) above random(2 × reputation + 1000) makes the bid: `shortlist_slot::FLAGS` bit 5 (`shortlist_slot_flags::BID_MARKER`) cleared, the local offer (`exe::new_transfer_offer`) filled (`exe::transfer_offer_build_bid`); with no offer, the status in the list (`exe::shortlist_manager_update_staff_status` with 1); with one, the bid (`exe::transfer_manager_add_transfer_offer`) and, with terms, the contract offer (`exe::contract_manager_add_contract_offer`) and, with an AI seller with no contract offer (`exe::contract_manager_find_contract_offer`) and with the target's contract (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract_for_club`), the renewal negotiation at the seller (`FN_CONTRACT_MANAGER_OFFER_CONTRACT` with the factor by squad status 1..5 and the seller's entry `exe::shortlist_manager_find_club_shortlist_entry`) and the terms freed; `shortlist_slot::OFFER_REF` = the offer index (`.slot_index()`) and the count goes up for a player slot. The local offer is destroyed (`exe::drop_transfer_offer`). 
 Loan slot (bit 0, `shortlist_slot_flags::LOAN_SLOT`): not a French club (`[KEY_NATION_FRANCE]`) with `.professional_status()` = `professional_status::AMATEUR`; the loan possible (`exe::transfer_manager_can_loan_player`); a human seller without bit 2 (`transfer_status::LOAN_LISTED`) of the contract's `contract::TRANSFER_STATUS` skips; no offer (`exe::transfer_manager_club_has_offer_for_player`) and no exchange; random(`shortlist_slot::PRICE`) above random(reputation / 10), or above random(2 × reputation) on the second pair: the request (`exe::shortlist_manager_try_loan_offer_for_player`) in `shortlist_slot::OFFER_REF`; negative, the status in the list; otherwise the count goes up.

Values the player for the club: the player's rating for the slot (through the club's best observer, the scout list at a human club, the fog of war) and the fee the club would pay (base value, age, young players' perceived ability, injury proneness, the caps by position, reputation, record, age, division and the club's nation). Returns the price (_ftol). 
 Convention: thiscall, ret `0x18`, `shortlist_manager.cpp`, 4.6 KB of x87; the map gives 1332 bytes. `Shortlist_Manager::value_player_for_club(club, p, slot, out, minimum, ceiling)` (club, person, slot, output, minimum, cap), called from the scouting lists and the computer's offers (`0x83f3a0`, `0x842e10`, `0x843800`, `0x8c0810`, `0x8c8090`, `0x8c8860`, `0x8e5d60`). 
 The observer is the club's manager (`.manager()`; without sheet `staff::NON_PLAYER`, a random one, `exe::utils_random` over `[G_NON_PLAYER_COUNT]`, at `[G_NON_PLAYER_TABLE]` + `0x44` × i). The rating flags by slot type (`.flags()` & `0x1e`: 4 and 6 with `0x5882`, or `0x815882` for the human club's own player, and the reputation scope `exe::database_get_reputation_scope`; 8 with `0x5982` and the scope; otherwise `0x5902`); a loan-list slot (bit 0, `shortlist_slot_flags::LOAN_SLOT`) changes the minimum's divisor to 16 or 6 (`exe::staff_is_loan_listed`). Human club (`exe::human_manager_is_human_club` with 1, 1): its manager (`FN_DATABASE_GET_CLUB_MANAGER`) and, with the player on the scout's list (`exe::scout_manager_is_player_shortlisted`), the rating (`exe::match_man_score_player_for_selection` with −1 and the replacement `exe::human_manager_get_stand_in_manager`) becomes max(rating + 15000, rating × 1.5); otherwise the rating with minimum² × 0.000025 / divisor. Computer: with flag `0x100` (or `0x80`) the best observer between the manager and the 7 scouts (`.scouts(k)`) by knowledge (`exe::non_player_attribute_rating` with 6 or 5) minus 5 or 10 by the scope; the rating with the minimum and that observer, × 1.05 for a player transfer-listed by another club (`exe::staff_is_transfer_listed_or_requested`). A negative rating or 10000 below the minimum, or a loan-list slot: the end with no value (`loan_listed_value_end`). 
 The fog (`staff_state::STATUS_FLAGS` of the 79-byte record in `[G_STAFF_STATE_TABLE]`, 4 bits `staff_state_status_flags::AI_SHORTLIST_COUNT`) limits the rating to rating + 5000 by (1 + n²/100) × rating. By position (`exe::shortlist_position_mask_to_index`) the price cap and the fraction; the base value (high with rating ≥ 35000, the slot's `.price()` ≥ rating/8 and `.position()` ≥ `0x80`); the adjustment by slot type (1, 2, 3: the young players, `young_player_adjustment`; 3, 4, 5, 6: fractions); the age above the divisor (28, 32 with no position, 19 in slot 5) and the foreigner (`exe::database_is_staff_foreign`); the price by injury proneness (`.injury_proneness()` of sheet `.player()`) and the cap by slot type, reputation, record (`+0xd`) and age; above 1.5 million, a perceived potential ability (`FN_MATCH_MAN_JUDGE_PLAYER_ABILITY` with 2) below 145 pulls it to 1.5 million; the limit of the club's division (`.division()`, `.reputation()` < 16); the club's nation (`.nation()`) `[KEY_NATION_PORTUGAL]` or `[KEY_NATION_FRANCE]`; with `ceiling`, at most the slot's `+7` (at least 1).

Sets to 100 the day counter of the entry of every club that targets the player and, with `clear`, removes the bid marker from the slots holding him. \n Convention: thiscall, ret 8, `shortlist_manager.cpp`, SEH frame only for the new list. `Shortlist_Manager::suspend_clubs_shortlisting_player(player, clear)`: in a new LLIST (`exe::crt_operator_new(0xe)` and `exe::new_llist`) it gathers the clubs targeting the player (`exe::shortlist_manager_collect_interested_clubs` with ignore 1, mode 3, all); for each item (`exe::llist_get_next`, after resetting the cursor `.set_cursor(.head())`) it sets the day counter of the club's entry (`club_shortlist::DAYS`) to 100 and, with `clear`, removes the bid marker (`.offer_ref()` = −1 when > −1) from the slots that hold the player (`.target_staff_id()` = id). It destroys and frees the list (`exe::drop_llist`, `exe::crt_operator_delete`). The count (`+0`, signed 16 bits) is re-read on every pass, as in the original.

Decides whether the person is a realistic candidate for the club's manager job: vetoes and accepts by reputation, nation, contract and time in the job; otherwise their interest in the job against the minimum score (double). \n `MANAGER_MANAGER::is_staff_suitable_for_job(person, club, rating_minimum)`: without a non-player record (`.non_player()`) or without a club: 0. The vetoes (0): other-nation reputation (`non_player::WORLD_REPUTATION`) above 4250 from another nation with weight (`nation::LEAGUE_STANDARD`) below 10; domestic (`non_player::HOME_REPUTATION`) above 6250, a manager (`staff::JOB_FOR_CLUB` = 5) from another nation and a club below 5750; a national team that is one of the three clubs they dislike (`.staff_preferences()`, `preferences::STAFF_DISLIKED_CLUBS1`..`preferences::STAFF_DISLIKED_CLUBS3`); a player (0xb) with a rating (`.player()`, `.current_reputation()`) above 4750 at a club below 6750, with a contract (`exe::contract_manager_get_contract`) of band 1..3 (`contract::SQUAD_STATUS` >> 4), less than 180 days (`contract::DATE_STARTED`), `contract::MATCHES_LEFT_OUT` above 1, `contract::UNHAPPY_FLAG` zero, younger than 35 (`staff::AGE`) with `contract::HAPPINESS` positive, or from another nation at a club below 7250 that is not their own; a club manager in a better division (`club::DIVISION` `.reputation()`), or a stronger one, or recently appointed (days since `.date_joined_club()` below (`staff::LOYALTY` + 21) × 10) at a club above 5250; a national team manager (`.national_job()`, `staff::JOB_FOR_NATION` = 5); a club below 2250 (with reputation `non_player::CURRENT_REPUTATION` above 4750 or without a record); `staff::INT_APPS` above 75 at a club below 3250; a non-player with retirement pending (`exe::player_regen_is_retirement_pending`). The yeses (1): a club below 2500 of their nation, domestic below 1500, without a club or national team; their nation's national team with reputation below 6750, without a club, or with their club weaker (below 7750 and 750 below the national team) for a while; a club above 7750 with the perceived reputation (`perceived_club_reputation`) above their club's + 25 × `staff::LOYALTY` + 250. Otherwise, their interest in the job (`exe::staff_interest_in_job_at_club`, float) not below `rating_minimum`.

Removes the person from the transfer list: clears bit 0 of the contract's `.transfer_status()`; returns 1 with a contract, 0 without. \n `shortlist_manager_remove_from_transfer_list(person)`, called by the transfer screens (`0x8f6770`, `0x8f8120`). No contract (`contract_of_staff`): 0. With one, bit 0 of `.transfer_status()` (on the transfer list) is cleared and it returns 1 in the low byte (the upper ones are those of the contract pointer, as in the original).
